content.rendered:
Welcome Back Letter 2018/19

The LRMS school office will reopen on Monday,  August 20th.  

Registration Open House will take place Thursday, August 23rd – Friday, August 24th for all students as follows:

Thursday, August 23rd, 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.
Friday, August 24th, 9:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.

During the Open House we will hand out schedules and locker numbers, collect fees and have PE clothes available to purchase.  More information around the Registration Open House can be found in the Welcome Back Letter.
